platforms.name: Groover Paid Curator Playlist Radio Label DJ Submission Route
platforms.country: Global / France and US-based music promotion and curator-access platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official Groover page says contacting a curator/pro costs 2 Grooviz, 1 Grooviz equals EUR 1 tax included, and top-tier curators may cost 4-6 Grooviz; exact curator mix and credit spend require owner approval.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for signup/login, credit purchase, curator selection, track link or upload choice, pitch text, genre fit, radio/label/DJ targeting and spend authorization. No account was created, no credits were purchased and no music was submitted.
platforms.notes: Official Groover page exposes a Send my music route, 3,000+ curators/pros, guaranteed feedback within seven days, playlist/press/radio/label/DJ/manager routes, all-genre support including electronic, reggae and world/spiritual, and paid Grooviz credit requirements. Public business submission email was not observed. Cookie management was observed but not acted on.

platforms.name: Playlist Push Paid Spotify TikTok Curator Campaign Submission Route
platforms.country: Global / US-based Spotify playlist and TikTok creator music-promotion platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official Playlist Push page links pricing and states flexible pricing; campaigns require owner-controlled budget and payment review before any playlist or TikTok creator submission.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account creation, campaign targeting, Spotify/TikTok asset readiness, budget, payment authorization, campaign claims, release timing and anti-bot/compliance review. No account was created and no campaign was started.
platforms.notes: Official Playlist Push page exposes Create Account/Get Started/Submit to Playlists app links, Spotify playlist and TikTok creator promotion routes, vetted curator claims, reporting dashboard language, flexible pricing and protection-fund/curator-review boundaries. Public business submission email was not observed.

platforms.name: Spinnin Records Talent Pool Login Demo Upload Route
platforms.country: Global / Netherlands-based electronic dance label talent-pool route
platforms.feeAmount: No payment requirement was observed on the public Talent Pool page in this run; uploading requires account/login and owner-controlled demo review.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/login, demo ownership, SoundCloud/audio-link readiness, label fit, remix/sample rights, public ranking visibility and terms acceptance. No login was used and no demo was uploaded.
platforms.notes: Official Spinnin Records Talent Pool page exposes Log in to submit your demo, current most-popular/latest-additions track listings, contests/news navigation, and a cookie-settings boundary. Public business submission email was not observed.

platforms.name: RepostExchange SoundCloud Partner Repost Feedback Campaign Route
platforms.country: Global / UK-based SoundCloud community promotion and feedback platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official page says the platform is free to use and new members receive free credits; paid credits/plans exist as optional acceleration routes and require owner approval if used.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required before connecting SoundCloud, choosing tracks, requesting reposts, spending credits, accepting reposts/feedback, using optional paid credits/plans or authorizing any social action. No SoundCloud connection was made and no campaign was started.
platforms.notes: Official RepostExchange page describes an official SoundCloud partner, 500,000+ SoundCloud creators, free-to-use community promotion, connect-with-SoundCloud route, repost requests/campaigns, feedback, genres including electronic, deep house, EDM, trap and house, and explicit anti-bot/manual-action boundaries. Public business submission email was not observed.
